h: Steel, Science and a Country Park
p: First things first: check AirHop's own website for the current status of the Rotherham park before you set off, so you're not left with disappointed faces in the car park. Once it's up and running, the Parkgate Retail Park location makes it easy to reach from the A633 and the wider South Yorkshire road network.

Rotherham has a proud industrial past, and the best place to feel it is Magna Science Adventure Centre at Templeborough. It's set inside an enormous former steelworks and is all about hands-on science, with fire, water, earth and air zones that kids can get stuck into. Pairing it with a bouncing session would make a proper action-packed day.

For fresh air, Rother Valley Country Park on the southern edge of the borough has lakes, cycle paths and water sports, plus plenty of space for a picnic. Roche Abbey, near Maltby, is a peaceful ruined abbey in a beautiful valley, perfect for a slower afternoon.
Back in town, Clifton Park Museum tells the story of Rotherham and its people, and Rotherham Minster is the grand medieval church at the heart of the town centre.
Just over the border in Barnsley, Elsecar Heritage Centre is a former ironworks village with craft shops and a heritage railway that runs on selected dates.
As ever with retail parks, weekends get busy, so an early arrival makes life a lot easier.

Rotherham United play at the New York Stadium near the town centre, so it's worth a glance at the fixtures if you're driving through on a Saturday. For a quiet coffee and a sit-down after a busy day, the Parkgate area has plenty of chain cafés and restaurants right on hand.
